programmes.d: The Conners struggle to accept Becky's new boyfriend, a big Packers fan.
Darlene’s thrilled when Harris gets into Central Illinois State, but she may have other plans.
The Conners share their opinions on voting; Louise gets an offer that could take her away from Lanford.
Dan avoids coping with a death, only to be faced with it head-on; Ben and Darlene address his baby fever.
Dan begins to bond with his younger half-brother but is angry their dad paid for Ed Jr.'s college education.
Darlene gets a job at Price Warehouse; Ben shaves his beard to look more clean-cut to advertisers.
Newly unemployed Harris moves back into the house; the entire Conner family contemplate tattoos.
Back from Arizona, Bev announces she wants to use her money to spread joy; she offers to pay Mark's tuition.
Dan’s ready to share his feelings with Louise; Darlene realizes how badly she wants a baby.
Dan and Louise take their relationship to the next level; Darlene spends the night in jail.
Darlene and Ben go apartment hunting; Jackie and Becky take Beverly Rose to Mexico to meet her father.
The Conners must deal with the pandemic; The Lunch Box closes for everything but takeout and delivery.

Darlene isolates herself from her co-workers, making them think she’s an elite snob.
It's Beverly Rose's first birthday, but Becky and Emilio disagree on the kind of celebration she should have.
Darlene's friendship with a manager at Wellman Plastics lands her in an awkward situation.
Harris' job is in jeopardy after joining a protest she believes in; Jackie makes a visit to Wellman Plastics.
Ben's mom arrives after an unexpected death and unveils shocking information from the past.
Harris brings home her new friend, Josh, leaving the family questioning his intentions.
Darlene earns a promotion at Wellman Plastics, while Ben decides on a new career path.

Darlene starts to feel the pressures of her new job; Dan attempts to help Ben out at the hardware store.
Mark’s sure he has COVID; Becky and Harris team up to confront Josh who’s been 'ghosting' Harris.

Dan encounters a surprise visitor who shares some unsolicited advice, leaving him feeling guilty.
Mark is stressed and exhausted from studying for an important entrance exam, so Darlene steps in to help.
Darlene makes a decision about her trip to Hawaii, leading to a heated encounter with Barb.
Two proposals bring big changes to the Conner family; Jackie uses her Jeopardy! infamy to her advantage.
The Conners continue to deal with the pandemic while navigating breakups and newfound sobriety.
After Ben declines Darlene's proposal, she starts to ponder why she tends to be so negative in life.
Becky's recovery program mandates she apologize to people she’s lied to, leading to a reunion with a friend.

The Conners are ready for Halloween, despite a leaky roof that forces Dan and Louise to cancel their honeymoon
Darlene worries about Mark making friends at his new school; Mark turns to Ben for personal advice.
When Jackie devises a plan of how to serve the customers at The Lunch Box, it's anything but smooth service.
As Louise begins moving into the Conner home, Dan decides to sell the furniture he bought for Roseanne.
Darlene and Nick run into Ben who invites Nick to join him at The Lunch Box to watch a Bears game.
The Conners celebrate Mark when he makes Dean's List at his new magnet school.
Dan offers to talk with Aldo's dad when he doesn't approve of Harris and Aldo's relationship.
Mark finds it hard fitting in at school; Darlene’s upset about how Mark's earning extra cash for college.
Darlene convinces Ben to pretend to be her partner so she has a better chance at getting a house.
The family is locked down in their home due to a shooting incident in the neighborhood.
When Becky outs her relationship with Professor Davis, his behavior causes Becky to reevaluate her feelings.
When an attempt to boost business at The Lunch Box fails, Jackie finds herself rethinking her future plans.
Dan enlists a few friends to help him with the funeral home remodel; Robin and Darlene take a big career risk.
Darlene struggles to cope with the stress of construction; Lou returns as Mark's contrabassoon teacher.
Ben and Darlene are excited to share their good news with the family, but others share their own similar news.
The Conners gear up for the mega-wedding, but they quickly discover not everyone is on the same page.
To save money, Darlene and Ben & Jackie and Neville head off on a joint honeymoon.
When Jackie moves in with Neville, he brings an excess of animals from his vet office.
Darlene tries teaching Mark to drive, but her manic energy sends him running to Ben; Harris meets a guy online
When a relative passes away, the family must debate about who should gain custody of a jaded nephew.
Problems arise on Beverly Rose's first day of kindergarten; Becky and Darlene have a disagreement.
Harris takes a stand on an issue that ruffles a few feathers in Darlene's new neighborhood.
